Name: Upgradable Pan
Author: GrendG
Description:
If you're anything like me, you've always thought it was kinda weird that you couldn't upgrade the Copper Pan.  I mean, it's a tool right?
This mod enables upgrades for the Copper Pan--upgrade it to steel, gold, and iridium like any other tool.
 
Upgraded versions of the pan increase chance for rare items, quantity of panned items, tool range, and even adds a few surprises!
Because the pan acts as a real tool now, you can no longer throw them away or buy new ones at Willy's shop.  Sorry!
